title: Gece yarısı mutfak

characters.MOTHER: a mother in her forties with wavy auburn hair, wearing a mustard yellow sweater
characters.TEEN: a teenage boy of about fifteen with messy dark hair, wearing a grey hoodie

scenes.text:
Ergen çocuğun kapısını çarptığında,
sandığın gibi senden kaçmıyor.
scenes.prompt: In a dim hallway at home in the evening, {MOTHER} stands looking at a closed bedroom door with a worried, gentle face, warm lamp light, rain on the hallway window.
At a dinner table in warm lamp light, {TEEN} on the right looks down silently, while {MOTHER} on the left looks at him hopefully, two bowls of soup on the table.

scenes.text:
Sonra bir gece yarısı, tam sen yorgunken,
mutfağa gelip konuşmaya başlar.
scenes.prompt: Late at night in a kitchen lit by a single small lamp, {MOTHER} sits tired at the table, and {TEEN} stands shyly in the kitchen doorway, rain on the dark window.

scenes.text:
Okul, arkadaşlar, kırılan kalbi;
her şey o saatte dökülür.
scenes.prompt: Late at night at the kitchen table, {TEEN} on the right talks openly, and {MOTHER} on the left listens closely, two cups of tea and a glowing candle on the table in front of them, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
O gece "Yarın konuşuruz" deme.
Bunu ergen çocuğu olan birine gönder.
scenes.prompt: In the warm candle-lit kitchen late at night, {MOTHER} on the left and {TEEN} on the right laugh together at the table, rain softly running down the dark window.

caption:
Gece yarısı dinle.

Ergenler en önemli şeyleri en yorgun saatinde anlatır. 🤍

Bunu ergen çocuğu olan birine gönder.
